fixes.P0301: Likely a fouled spark plug or failing ignition coil on cylinder 1. Check plug condition and coil resistance before replacing.
fixes.P0171: Check for a vacuum leak or a dirty MAF sensor first — both are common causes of a lean Bank 1 reading.
fixes.P0455: Inspect the gas cap seal and EVAP hoses for a loose or cracked connection — the most common source of a large leak code.

location.title: Where would you like your assistance?
location.sub: A mobile technician comes to you: home, work or wherever your vehicle is.
location.currentLocationSub: Where this phone is right now.
location.permissionDenied: Location permission is off. Turn it on in Settings, or pick a saved address.
location.locationFailed: We couldn't find your location. Try again or pick a saved address.
location.noCoords: We couldn't place that address on the map. Pick another one.
location.contactTitle: WHO IS IN THE VEHICLE TO RECEIVE ASSISTANCE?
location.subChoose: A technician comes to you, or you take your vehicle to a repair shop.
location.modeOnsiteSub: A mobile technician comes to you. Home, work or wherever your vehicle is.
location.modeShopSub: You take your vehicle to a repair shop in your area. Shops near you send quotes.
location.shopNote: We'll invite repair shops within {{count}} mile of this address to send you a quote. You choose which one to book.
location.shopNote_other: We'll invite repair shops within {{count}} miles of this address to send you a quote. You choose which one to book.

services.title: What do you need done?
services.sub: Open a category and select every service you want quoted.
services.empty: No services are available right now.

availability.title: When do you need it?
availability.sub: Choose your preferred date and time window, and add anything that helps mechanics and shops quote.
availability.sameDayTitle: Service for today: reduced quote window.
availability.sameDayBody: Offers close 1 hour before your requested time. Same-day availability depends on the technicians in your area.
availability.windowBody: Offers stay open for up to 48 hours, or until 1 hour before your requested time if that comes first.
availability.symptomsPlaceholder: Symptoms, faults you noticed, specific requests…
availability.evidenceLimits: Up to 5 files · photos up to 5 MB · videos up to 50 MB
availability.tooBig: Some files were skipped because they are too large.
availability.detailsSub: Symptoms or special requests, so quotes are accurate.

review.title: Review your request
review.sub: Check everything before it's sent to technicians and shops for quotes.
review.noChargeBody: Publishing only requests quotes. Offers stay open for up to 48 hours, or until 1 hour before your requested time if that comes first. You can accept a valid offer as soon as it arrives. Your exact address and plate are shared only after you accept an offer and payment is secured.

sent.title: Request sent
sent.body: Nothing has been charged. Eligible technicians and shops can now quote, and you'll be notified as each offer arrives.
sent.offersUntilValue: Up to 48 h, or 1 h before your time

errors.publishFailedMessage: Your progress is saved as a draft. Check your connection and try again.
errors.serviceUnavailableTitle: A service is no longer available
errors.serviceUnavailableMessage: Please review the services you selected.
errors.dateInvalidMessage: The requested time has to be at least an hour from now.
errors.sessionExpiredMessage: Please sign in again. Your progress is saved as a draft.

requestAgain.error: We couldn't prepare a new request. Please try again.

scheduled.cancelNote: Cancelling before the provider heads out releases the held amount. After that, the hold stays and support decides how much is charged.

scheduledOffers.title: Offers
scheduledOffers.waitingSub: Providers near you are reviewing your request. We'll notify you when an offer arrives.

detail.diagnosticSub: This is the diagnostic fee. The provider quotes the repair after inspecting.
detail.unavailable: This offer is no longer available.

pay.title: Review and pay
pay.holdNow: The amount is held on your payment method now and only charged when the service is done.
pay.holdLater: The amount is held 24 hours before the service and only charged when it is done.
pay.diagnosticNote: Only the diagnostic fee is held now. You approve any repair quote before it is charged.

done.title: Offer selected
done.holdNow: The amount is held on your payment method.
done.holdLater: The amount will be held 24 hours before the service.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.priceChanged: The price changed. Review the new total and confirm again.
errors.offerGone: That offer is no longer available.
errors.funds: Not enough balance. Add funds or use another payment method.
errors.disabled: Accepting offers isn't available for your account yet.
errors.location: We couldn't determine taxes for this location.

scheduledOffers.reopened: Your provider cancelled and your request is receiving offers again.
scheduledOffers.cancelledSub: This request is cancelled. You can start a new one with the same details.
scheduledOffers.noOffersSub: The offer window closed without offers. Give providers more time or start a new request with other dates.

hub.title: Receiving offers
hub.sub: Eligible technicians and shops are reviewing your request. Accept a valid offer anytime — no need to wait.
hub.leftNote: left in the quote window · closes in 48 h, or 1 h before your service if sooner
hub.privacy: Nothing has been charged. Providers can't see your exact address or plate until you accept an offer and payment is secured.

compare.title: Compare offers
compare.sub: Provider names are shared once you accept and your payment is secured. Offers that cover fewer services are marked as partial, so totals aren't directly comparable.
compare.totalNote: "Your total" is calculated by Mechanic Assistance and includes applicable fees and taxes.

finalQuote.title: Final quote
finalQuote.sub: The provider inspected your vehicle and proposed the final price for the whole job.
finalQuote.note: Approving holds only the difference. You are charged when the service is done.
finalQuote.closed: This quote can no longer be decided.
finalQuote.none: There is no quote to review.

banner.title: Final quote to review
banner.sub: Your provider proposed the final price.

approved.title: Quote approved
approved.sub: The additional amount was held and your provider can continue.

rejected.title: Quote declined
rejected.sub: No extra money was held. The service ends with only the diagnostic.

reject.title: Decline this quote?
reject.message: The service will end with only the diagnostic fee.

errors.gone: This quote is no longer available.

scheduledProvider.title: Scheduled request
scheduledProvider.areaHint: Exact address unlocks once the customer accepts and pays

details.title: Review and send your quote.
details.sub: Customers compare quotes for up to 48 hours, or until 1 hour before the requested time. Send yours before the window closes.

quote.title: Price the job.
quote.sub: Quote the services you can do. Customers can compare partial and full offers.
quote.servicesHint: This is where you build your quote: switch on each service you can do and enter its price.
quote.partialBody: Not included: {{list}}. The customer will see it flagged as partial.
quote.partsHint: Turn off if the customer supplies parts.
quote.arriveTitle: WHEN CAN YOU ARRIVE AT THE CUSTOMER'S?
quote.setArrivalHint: Pick the day and time you can arrive, and how long the job will take.
quote.messagePlaceholder: Tell the customer what's included, tools you'll bring, anything they should prepare…
quote.protect: Don't share phone numbers or ask to talk outside the app. The customer's protection and warranty only apply to jobs handled here.

problems.services: Select at least one service you can do
problems.prices: Add a price for every service you selected
problems.arrival: Pick an arrival day and time that is still ahead

review.title: Check your quote.
review.sub: The customer sees this exactly as it is. You can edit it until they accept.
review.feesNote: The customer's total adds fees and taxes calculated by Mechanic Assistance.
review.confirm: I confirm I'm available at this time and can do the work I quoted. If the customer accepts, I commit to showing up.

sent.title: Quote sent
sent.sub: The customer is comparing offers. We'll notify you as soon as they decide.
sent.note: You're not confirmed yet. The job is yours only after the customer accepts and payment is secured, and the exact address is released then.

decline.title: Skip this request?
decline.sub: It's removed from your list on this phone. Tell us why so we send you better matches.

reasons.dates: You're not available on those dates

declined.title: Request declined
declined.sub: We removed it from your list. You won't see it again.

awarded.title: You got the job!
awarded.sub: The customer accepted your quote and payment is secured.

notSelected.title: Not selected this time
notSelected.sub: The customer chose another offer. Nothing was charged and there's nothing else for you to do.
notSelected.tip: Tip: quoting every requested service, with a clear message and a fast reply, helps your offers stand out.

withdrawn.title: Quote withdrawn
withdrawn.sub: The customer can no longer select your quote.

expired.title: The quote window closed
expired.sub: This request stopped accepting quotes before you sent yours.

errors.generic: We couldn't send your quote. Check your connection and try again.
errors.load: We couldn't load this request. Try again in a moment.
errors.closed: Offers for this request are closed.
errors.slot: Pick an arrival time that is still ahead.
errors.price: Check the prices and try again.
errors.description: Add a short description and try again.

notProvider.title: This account is not a provider
notProvider.body: Scheduled requests are only for technician accounts.

identityPending.title: Verify your identity to see scheduled requests
identityPending.body: Your identity check is not approved yet. Finish it to start quoting.

suspended.title: Scheduled requests are paused for you
suspended.body: Contact support to get access back.

notEnabled.title: Scheduled requests are not enabled yet
notEnabled.body: Your account is not enabled for scheduled requests yet. Try again later or contact support.

baseLocationMissing.title: Add your base address
baseLocationMissing.body: We need an address with a location to show you nearby scheduled requests.

noCategories.title: No service categories assigned
noCategories.body: Your account has no service categories yet, so there is nothing to match. Contact support.

welcome.sub: Certified technicians, right when you need them.

chooseRole.title: Which profile do you want to use?
chooseRole.subtitle: You can switch anytime from your profile.

notificationsPopup.offerAcceptedBody: The customer accepted your offer to help.
